choreography.startupIntent: Retract the right wrist piston while the feet and core remain planted.
choreography.heroContact: Short square piston punch with the shoulder block behind the wrist; the contact silhouette must read without sparks.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Expose the piston rod and visibly re-pressurise before the forearm returns.

bodyNotes: No boxing extension beyond the declared piston travel.
The left forearm remains a pressure-control guard.

choreography.startupIntent: Load across the rear anchor, raise the heavy forearm and close the shoulder brace.
choreography.heroContact: Broad descending hammer line with the entire shoulder and torso mass committed.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Piston and shoulder continue a few pixels past contact before the heel anchors absorb the load.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Leave the forearm low and the torso pitched forward long enough to read as punishable.

bodyNotes: The forearm remains attached to its declared wrist mount.
Do not turn the pose into a human haymaker.

choreography.startupIntent: Compress over both feet and expose the front heel ram.
choreography.heroContact: Compact low toe/heel strike; reach comes from declared foot hardware, not leg stretching.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Retract the ram before the pelvis rises.

choreography.startupIntent: Lower one forearm and rotate the hips as a single load-bearing unit.
choreography.heroContact: Wide low forearm sweep with a clear horizontal lane and anchored opposite foot.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: The sweeping arm drags low before hydraulic recovery restores the torso.

choreography.startupIntent: Tuck the knees enough to keep the piston line visible.
choreography.heroContact: Short downward piston contact beneath the torso.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Retract the wrist and prepare both feet for landing.

choreography.startupIntent: Fold the lower body beneath the core and turn the broad underside toward the target.
choreography.heroContact: Wide compact descending press using the whole lower chassis.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Land in deep compression, then force the anchors back into line.

choreography.startupIntent: Lock the forearm tool, close the shoulder brace and pre-load the rear heel anchor.
choreography.heroContact: Straight armoured drive with the bore line, shoulder and rear leg forming one force path.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Piston travel recoils visibly through the shoulder and torso before the anchors release.

choreography.startupIntent: Open both forearm clamps and lower the centre of mass without advancing the feet.
choreography.heroContact: Secure the opponent between the declared forearm tools, rotate through the hips and force a short industrial wrench.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Release cleanly, vent both clamps and restore the front guard.

bodyNotes: This is a mechanical clamp, not an invisible telekinetic grab.
Receiver choreography must be paired and size-safe.

choreography.startupIntent: Compact the torso and close all nonessential shutters.
choreography.heroContact: Emergency pressure discharge around a short defensive body snap.
choreography.activeOvershoot: Preserve the contact line for one held cel, then show a physically coherent overshoot.
choreography.recoveryIntent: The Frame remains visibly vent-open and vulnerable while pressure rebuilds.

choreography.startupIntent: Heel anchors lock, dorsal shutters open and furnace light rises through the sternum.
choreography.heroContact: An enormous piston verdict with the forearm, shoulder, core and rear anchor aligned.
choreography.activeOvershoot: The forearm drive continues through contact into a controlled structural stop.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Bastion remains low and venting while the piston returns under visible load.

choreography.startupIntent: Clamp at the shoulder and waist with both forearms.
choreography.heroContact: Pivot on the rear heel anchor and drive the receiver to the floor in front.
choreography.recoveryIntent: Maintain one bracing hand until the receiver clears, then reset.

superPresentation.entry: horizontal left cut-in behind a heavy warning rail
superPresentation.bodyPriority: Bastion remains fully readable; flame and pressure layers sit behind and beyond the contact arm.
superPresentation.impactFreezeCue: bone-white two-frame flash, oxide-red silhouette hold, furnace-orange aftershock
superPresentation.audioCue: breaker lock, hydraulic chamber, Branka call, structural impact
